tooltip.fweapons.gblueprint: Allows you to smith your mace with a diamond block.
adv.fweapons.obtain.airmace.desc: When all hope was lost and as swords and maces became of no use, the clouds gave humanity the last weapon to save mankind. And upon earth heath descended the Aero Mace.
adv.fweapons.obtain.antem.desc: Arm yoursef with Ante Meridem, a heavy sword capable of bringing kings to their knees.
adv.fweapons.obtain.hcbowprint.desc: Romans have alway loved BIG bows
adv.fweapons.obtain.hcbow.desc: Shoot at your foes through the newly equiped Heavy Crossbow. But be warned, it’s recoil with rockets is more powerful than it might seem.
adv.fweapons.obtain.thefool.desc: Gain the company of The Fool, bow which changes the positions of its holder and targets. It truly makes them feel like fools.
adv.fweapons.obtain.dshield.desc: Emerging from the depths of void the Endefender boosts not only your ego (because of its aura) but also you resistance.
adv.fweapons.obtain.harvester.desc: The sickle bears the name Harvester and not without a reason, heads of thy foes will fall of and their loot will be merry. Let the harvest begin…
adv.fweapons.obtain.dusk.desc: There were once twins, the older one, one with a peace, spread kindess and merciful death.
adv.fweapons.obtain.lscythe.desc: Let the air wiggle by electricity radiating from the Malice of the Thunder God. Weapon so fierce, it allows you to dash through the battlefield.
adv.fweapons.obtain.dawn.desc: There were once twins, the younger one, full of rage, inflicted harm to the world around him.
adv.fweapons.obtain.sacrilegious.desc: Toughen your arms and sharpen your blade as up is sometimes down and heavens are no exception. Heaven upside down is a monstrous claymore able to turn even the skyes as it likes.
adv.fweapons.obtain.vaporwave_sword.desc: Slash your foes with the one handled sword divirgent sila divine Aesthetic and cause them to lose sense of literally everything.
adv.fweapons.obtain.dream_essence.desc: Slay the keeper of an Ancient city
adv.fweapons.obtain.mkopi.desc: When you’ve awoken up, it was there. It watches you dream. And those pierced by it will feel like they’ve fallen into a horrific nightmare.
adv.fweapons.obtain.natureaxe.desc: Unveil the force of nature with In Bloom. It’s an axe which utilises remains (ostatky) of its victims to empower surrounding flora.
adv.fweapons.obtain.bayonet.desc: Lay your hands on the Clamor Doloris. Even its first shot seems as a mountain destroying force, but the true power only shows after this petite warm up.
adv.fweapons.obtain.blue_katana.desc: Unsheathe The Cerulean Shade. Katana with the splendid ability to remain unseen by others. Though it comes with a price….
adv.fweapons.obtain.gblueprint.desc: Craft a scroll with the power of smithing the mace into a much more heavenly weapon.
